Name: Greenhouse Overkill
Author: zukane2
Description:
Requires latest version of [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url]﻿ by [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url]
Requires latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ by [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url]

[b]How to install the mod:
[/b]1. Download the mod
2. Open the zip file
3. Extract it to Stardew Valley/Mods.

To uninstall the mod you just have to delete ""[b][CP] Greenhouse Overkill[/b]" folder from Stardew Valley/Mods.

Recommendation:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7456]Greenhouse Sprinklers[/url]

[b]Warning: If you currently have crops on your greenhouse you might want to harvest and pick up everything before installing this mod.[/b]
